info.title: KNGP at a glance
instructions: Truax Field, NAS Corpus Christi · Field elevation 19' MSL
Class D: surface to 2,500' AGL, 4.3 NM from the center of the airport
Pattern altitudes: Initial/Break 1,000' MSL · Pattern 800' MSL · Delta 2,000' MSL
Delta conforms to the pattern for the runway in use; with parallel runways it conforms to 13L/31R

info.title: Taxi: general rules
instructions: Stay 5' from the edge of all taxiways
Establish radio contact with Ground before entering an active taxiway
The TW-4 line is the non-controlled movement area, from the Transient Line to the intersection of Runway 4-22 and Charlie. Tower cannot see it, so you may taxi at a safe speed without calling Ground
Monitor Navy Corpus Ground · UHF CH 3 while in the line
Speeds: 5–7 kts in the line · 10–12 kts elsewhere
Outbound aircraft have right of way; do not overtake or pass without Ground approval
Get a crossing clearance for every runway on your route. Without one, hold short even if the runway is inactive
Transponder in altitude mode from 'Transponder and FLT No.' in the Before Taxi Checklist through 'Transponder' on the Engine Shutdown Checklist

info.title: Taxi: Kilo line loop
instructions: Leave your parking line and go counterclockwise around Kilo line
East side of Kilo (closest to the hangars): taxi north
West side of Kilo (closest to RWY 13L): taxi south
Aircraft already on the loop have right of way over aircraft entering from a parking line or the Bravo turnaround
Bravo turnaround: the break in Kilo parking near Bravo can be used to turn around in either direction. It is not cleared for two aircraft, so make sure it is clear before turning in
Keep wingtips abeam or aft of the APE's post during the brake checks of the Before Taxi Checklist
Engine starts are prohibited within 50' of fueling (nozzle in tank). A plane captain or lineman is required for all starts when maintenance is on duty

info.title: South flow: RWY 13L/R, 18, 22
instructions: Run-ups: Sierra run-ups (inside the non-controlled movement area, so no call to Ground is needed to get there)
Enter by taxiing inbound through Alfa line, between the tails, and enter from the east to park in the westernmost spot available
Pull forward only enough to turn the aircraft south, perpendicular to the taxiway; do not pull up to the black boxes
Fill from west to east. Do not taxi behind another aircraft
Tell Boomer and Ranger Base whenever the run-ups become full
Aircraft in Sierra run-ups give way to aircraft established on the Kilo loop
Once the run-up is complete, call Ground (see the taxi calls below)

info.title: North flow: RWY 04, 31L/R, 36
instructions: Run-ups: taxiway Echo
Taxi to the Charlie / Compass Rose intersection, hold short, and call Navy Corpus Ground for taxi clearance
Ground clears you to the Echo run-ups via Compass Rose, Echo
Fill from west to east; align the aircraft perpendicular to the taxiway. Do not taxi behind another aircraft
Once the run-up is complete, call Ground for further taxi

info.title: Holding short on RWY 04/22
instructions: Applies when holding short of RWY 18, 13L or 13R on 04/22
VFR aircraft offset to the right side of 04/22; IFR aircraft offset to the left side
Offset all the way to that side so another aircraft can taxi between the aircraft holding short
With several aircraft holding short of 13L, do not block taxiway Yankee
All other runways: hold short in sequence, in one line

info.title: Parking
instructions: Kilo, Alfa North, Bravo and Alfa lines: taxi into the line by taxiing between the tails

info.title: Arrival: Shamrock entry initial points
instructions: North flow (04, 31L/R, 36): at PT Shamrock turn 200°, maintain 1,000' MSL and slow to 200 KIAS toward PT Dimmit
RWY 31L/R: report initial abeam PT Dimmit, then turn right direct to the runway numbers at 1,000' MSL and 200 KIAS
RWY 04, 36: initial is PT Dimmit; from the Low Bridge, maneuver to intercept a 1 NM final
South flow (13L/R, 18, 22): at PT Shamrock turn 255° toward the northwest corner of TAMUCC, maintain 1,000' MSL, slow to 200 KIAS
RWY 22: report initial intercepting the extended centerline of 22, no closer than 3 NM (NGP 4 DME)
RWY 18: report initial crossing the extended centerline of 22, then turn inbound to 18
RWY 13L/R: report initial crossing the extended centerline of 18, then turn inbound to 13L/R

info.title: Arrival: pattern side by runway
instructions: RWY 13L: left · RWY 13R: right · RWY 18: right · RWY 22: right
RWY 04: left · RWY 31L: left · RWY 31R: right · RWY 36: left
VFR straight-in: south flow (13L/R, 18, 22) level at 800' MSL; north flow (04, 31L/R, 36) level at 500' MSL
Straight-in calls: south flow "Left base/Final, gear down"; north flow "Right base, gear down"
